title: Verify: LifecycleStepper has no execution helpers and still renders stages
summary: Replace the deriveStage test with a stepper export and render test
description: Replace game/frontend/tests/deriveStage.test.ts, which imports the removed deriveStage, with a test of the remaining module.
acceptance_criteria: Given the module namespace, when deriveStage is read, then it is undefined
Given status CLOSED, when the stepper renders, then the CLOSED step is current
Given the source file, when it is read, then it has no 'execution' text
technical_constraints: Unit tests only, no network; use Vitest and Testing Library as in adminStepper.test.tsx
Read the source with node:fs relative to the test file
definition_of_done: The new test passes and deriveStage.test.ts is deleted

steps.action: Delete this file, because deriveStage no longer exists and the import would fail.

Add three tests. (1) import * as mod from '../src/components/LifecycleStepper'; assert (mod as Record<string, unknown>).deriveStage is undefined and mod.stageIndex('CLOSED') is 1. (2) render <LifecycleStepper status="CLOSED" /> and assert the li with text CLOSED has aria-current='step' and the OPEN li has data-state='done'. (3) read ../src/components/LifecycleStepper.tsx with readFileSync and assert its lowercased text does not contain 'execution'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/lifecycleStepper.test.tsx
